title: Furnaces - Smelting Improved
description: A Simple Mod Which Adds Improvements to Minecraft's Existing Smelting Recipes While Staying Vanilla Friendly
body:
# Furnaces - Smelting Improved
A server side (single player friendly) mod which adds to and improves the existing smelting recipes for both the furnace and blast furnace.

## Raw Ore Block Smelting
![A Block of Raw Gold being smelted to a gold Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd8dabff1a6df619589038e3131796e59197fa6a.png)
Smelting a block of Raw ores provides a **10%** time reduction compared to individually smelting 9 raw ore individually

## Moss Removal (Furnace Only)
![Mossy cobblestone stairs being turned into cobblestone stairs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/757f1a7544d6222b53c150f2cbc65d07f156016f.png)
Allows for mossy stairs, walls and slabs to be smelted into their non-mossy counterpart (mossy cobblestone and mossy stone bricks smelt into the same as their non-mossy counterparts)

## Blast Furnace Imporvments
- Allowed smelting of Sands (sand, red sand, suspicious sand) into glass
- Added parity between furnace and blast furnace by allowing smelting of items like clay, clay balls, netherraack, stone, cobblestone, stone bricks and more.
